name: Human Genetics & Gen Cnsl (MS)

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.notes:
To receive a Master of Science degree in Human Genetics and Genetic Counseling from Stanford University, students must successfully complete the following:

• 84 units, including all of the required coursework as listed below (minimum grades of B- or better, Satisfactory, or Credit)

• Approximately six quarters of rotations and independent study projects in diverse settings

• All required aspects of the Graduate Student Research Project

• All required aspects of the Service and Outreach Requirement

• Formal presentations in Medical Genetics Grand Rounds and Human Genetics Journal Club

rules.name: Medical Genetics Seminar
rules.desc: Students are required to complete 6 quarters of GENE 284.

rules.name: Advanced Genetic Counseling Seminar
rules.desc: Students are required to complete 3 quarters of GENE 286.

rules.name: Research Elective
rules.desc: Complete one research elective course. A course may be chosen in conversation with a student's advisor.

transferPolicy: This program does not accept transfer or other external credit.
reviewNotes: The audit checks the 84 units, the 21 required courses, 13 units of GENE 276 fieldwork, 3 units of GENE 283 research, six quarters of GENE 284 and three of GENE 286, with every course passed with B- or better, Satisfactory or Credit. Checked by hand: the research elective you choose with your advisor, about six quarters of rotations, the Graduate Student Research Project, the service and outreach requirement, and the Grand Rounds and Journal Club presentations. Transfer credit is not accepted.
